activation.expires: The link expires in {{expiry}} and works only once. If it expires, ask whoever created the account to send it again, or use “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in screen.
activation.intro:
{{greeting}}

An account was created for you in Quality Data with the email {{email}}. To activate it, open this link and choose your password:
activation.notExpected: If you were not expecting this email, ignore it: without a password nobody can sign in to the account.
activation.subject: Activate your Quality Data account
activation.title: Activate your account

deleted.body:
{{greeting}}

An administrator deleted the account {{email}} in Quality Data: it can no longer be used to sign in and its sessions were closed.
deleted.mistake: If you think this is a mistake, talk to an administrator of Quality Data.
deleted.subject: Your Quality Data account was deleted
deleted.title: Your account was deleted

directory.body:
Hello,

We received a request to reset the password of the account {{email}} in Quality Data. This account signs in with the company directory (LDAP / Active Directory), so its password is changed there: ask your help desk or use your company's tool.

If you did not ask for this change, ignore this email.
directory.title: Your password is changed in the directory

account.label: Your account

linked.body:
{{greeting}}

An external account was linked to the account {{email}} in Quality Data: from now on it can also be used to sign in.
linked.notYou: If it was not you, unlink it from your profile (Linked accounts) and tell an administrator of Quality Data.
linked.subject: {{provider}} was linked to your Quality Data account
linked.title: A new way to sign in to your account

locked.body:
{{greeting}}

There were {{attempts}} attempts in a row to sign in to the account {{email}} in Quality Data with a wrong password, so it was locked for {{expiry}} to protect it. While it lasts, nobody can sign in, not even with the right password; afterwards, it can be tried again.
locked.notYou: If it was not you, someone is trying passwords on your account: tell an administrator of Quality Data and, if your password is easy to guess, change it.
locked.subject: Your Quality Data account was locked after failed attempts
locked.title: Your account was locked for a while

password.body:
{{greeting}}

The password of the account {{email}} in Quality Data was changed with a reset link, and every open session of the account was signed out.
password.subject: Your Quality Data password was changed
password.title: Your password was changed

account.passwordNotYou: If it was not you, someone else has access to the account: reset the password with “Forgot your password?” and tell an administrator of Quality Data.

reset.expires: The link expires in {{expiry}} and works only once. Changing the password signs the account out of every open session.
reset.intro:
{{greeting}}

We received a request to reset the password of the account {{email}} in Quality Data. To choose a new one, open this link:
reset.notYou: If you did not ask for this change, ignore this email: your password stays the same.
reset.subject: Reset your Quality Data password
reset.title: Reset your password

unlinked.body:
{{greeting}}

The account {{email}} in Quality Data can no longer be signed in to with {{provider}}.
unlinked.notYou: If it was not you, check the linked accounts in your profile and tell an administrator of Quality Data.
unlinked.subject: {{provider}} was unlinked from your Quality Data account
unlinked.title: A way to sign in to your account was removed

welcome.body:
{{greeting}}

The account {{email}} in Quality Data is now active with the password you chose. From now on you sign in with your email and that password.
welcome.subject: Your Quality Data account is active
welcome.title: Your account is active

report.installedAndReady: The installation is on version {{installed}} and {{version}} is ready.
report.label: Update
report.newVersion: A new version of Quality Data is available: {{version}}
report.notPrepared: Version {{version}} of Quality Data could not be prepared
report.nothingTouched: Nothing was touched: the installation stays as it was.
report.restored: Version {{version}} did not start: the backup was restored
report.restoredDetail: Neither the new version nor the previous one started on the updated database, so the backup taken right before starting was restored (with no runs in progress). Whatever was done in those minutes may be missing.
report.rolledBack: Version {{version}} did not start: Quality Data stays on {{from}}
report.rolledBackDetail: The new version did not respond, so it went back to the previous one on the same database. Nothing was lost and it will not retry by itself.
report.succeeded: The update finished successfully and everything is working again.
report.updatedTo: Quality Data was updated to version {{version}}
report.urgentDidNotComeBack: URGENT: Quality Data did not come back after updating
